questions.prompt: Why did Julia jog along the beach? JR
questions.passage:
Julia jogged along the beach every evening. She would go from one end to the other and then back. It was a good way to stay fit. There were others who did the same, and they would wave as they passed each other.

Yesterday there was a small group of joggers stopped about halfway along the beach. When she reached them, she saw they were gathered looking at a seal pup that had come ashore. She stopped for a few minutes with them and then moved on. As she turned at the far end of the beach, she could see that both the group of people and the seal had gone.

questions.prompt: Where do the ducks find their food? G
questions.passage:
If you keep ducks you will need to provide them with water. Water is important to ducks for drinking and finding food in. From the water they will eat things such as water plants and frogs.

They don't spend all their time on the water though. Ducks will also patrol your garden and eat the slugs, snails and worms. This makes them very useful as these creatures are pests.

questions.prompt: About how long does a drag race last? JR
questions.passage:
DRAGSTERS

Dragsters are made for fast racing. In fact they are the fastest racing cars in the world. They can cover 400 metres down a special track called a drag strip in only five seconds. And that is about as long as a drag race lasts!

To go so fast, a dragster must not be heavy or carry any extra weight. Because it has to be light it is really only a frame with an engine, a fuel tank and just enough room for the driver. There are two big rear wheels and two very small wheels in front. The driver is protected by a roll-bar. He has to be in case the dragster flips over. There are usually only two cars in a drag race. Sometimes it is just one dragster racing against the clock.

Dragsters use special, very powerful fuel called nitro-methane. This is a bit like the fuel used to power rockets. This also helps them to go so fast. Some dragsters have no brakes. After they pass the finish line the driver releases a parachute to stop.

Drag racing is exciting to watch but don't turn away during a race. Five seconds isn't very long. You might miss it!
